expectations.buyer: Digital-wallet users, relying parties, wallet providers, privacy officers, and public-service designers
expectations.pain: People cannot tell why an attribute is requested or whether a smaller disclosure is sufficient
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Wallet consent screens, selective disclosure, relying-party policy, GDPR notices, identity standards, and privacy counsel
expectations.biggestRisk: The wallet and relying party control the request; a third-party assistant lacks authoritative legal and transaction context
